:::{#exr-prereq-stack-queue}
#### Stacks and queues

1. Start with an empty stack and perform these operations in order:

   push 5, push 8, push 2, pop, push 7, pop, pop.

   List the values the three pops return, in order,
   and say what is left on the stack.

2. Do the same with an empty queue,
   reading "push" as "add to the back" and "pop" as "remove from the front".

:::
